mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative FEDFUNDS trend, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward movement in UNRATE above 5.4% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened inflation expectations.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative when UNRATE crosses the 5.4% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A leading ratio of GDPC1 to HOUST exceeding 1.1 for one month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days, indicating stronger demand growth.
failure_condition: Ratio does not exceed 1.1 or 5d returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A late-cycle expansion characterized by INDPRO exceeding 118 and stable CPIAUCSL (change <1%) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as market anticipates peak demand.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO >118 and CPIAUCSL change <1% in previous month
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when in late-cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO indicates expanding supply capacity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise or 20d returns remain non-positive.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in PAYEMS below 130,000 employees in one month triggers negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days, signaling labor market weakness.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when PAYEMS drops below threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 by >0.2% and >0.5% respectively in one month signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.2% and GDPC1 rises >0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20d returns positive despite both proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: A post-shock recovery regime defined by UNRATE <5.0% and FEDFUNDS <2.2% for one month predicts positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as markets stabilize.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive in the post-shock regime.
